title: Memory panel with units
intro: Raw numbers like 352321536 confuse everyone. Build a panel for api memory that people can actually read.

objectives.text: Add a time series panel of memory_bytes for service="api" with unit Bytes

solution: Time series panel, query memory_bytes{service="api"}, unit Bytes (IEC)
debrief: Units turn numbers into meaning. Notice api-1 climbing steadily: a slow leak you would want to alert on.
